take: The Islanders announced they placed forwards Matias Maccelli and Calum Ritchie on injured reserve, retroactive to Oct. 17. Maccelli had 2 goals and 4 assists in 8 games, and the team controlled 55.97% of the 5-on-5 expected goals (chance quality) with him on the ice. Over the 3 games since both went out, Simon Holmstrom has moved onto the first power-play unit and is up to 19:59 a night from 15:43, with Kyle Palmieri at 17:39 from 15:38. Kyle MacLean and Emil Heineman have taken the vacated line spots.
